__doc: Per-name holdings and payouts, read from this token's own Stockify index
panel by scripts/holdings-probe.mjs and refreshed twice an hour by
.github/workflows/holdings.yml. Every figure is printed on that page;
nothing here is computed or inferred, and a field the page does not show
is null, which the site renders as an em dash.
This first entry is a real reading taken at the readAt timestamp below,
not a placeholder — but it IS a point-in-time reading, which is why it
carries that timestamp and why the schedule replaces it.
